stem: The doctor _____ treated me yesterday was very kind.
explanation_tr: Insanlar icin ilgi zamiri olarak 'who' kullanilir. Dun beni tedavi eden doktor cok nazikti.
tip_tr: Boslugun ardindan fiil geliyorsa ve onceki isim insansa who kullan.
extra_example: The nurse who gave me the injection was very professional. (Bana igneyi yapan hemsire cok profesyoneldi.)

stem: The medication _____ the doctor prescribed helped me a lot.
explanation_tr: Esya/nesne icin ilgi zamiri olarak 'which' kullanilir. Doktorun yazdigi ilac bana cok yardimci oldu.
tip_tr: Onceki isim insan degil, nesne/kavramsa which veya that kullan.
extra_example: The thermometer which I bought is very accurate. (Aldigim termometre cok hassas.)

stem: She is the patient _____ has been waiting since 8 o'clock.
explanation_tr: 'That' hem insanlar hem nesneler icin kullanilabilir. Ozellikle superlative ve 'the' sonrasi tercih edilir.
tip_tr: That hem insan hem nesne icin gecerli. Ama virgullu (non-defining) cumlede that KULLANILMAZ.
extra_example: The hospital that we visited was very modern. (Ziyaret ettigimiz hastane cok moderndi.)

stem: This is the hospital _____ my mother had her surgery.
explanation_tr: Yer bildiren isimlerden sonra 'where' kullanilir. Bu, annemin ameliyat oldugu hastane.
tip_tr: Hospital, clinic, room gibi yer isimleri + where. In which ile de degistirilebilir.
extra_example: The pharmacy where I buy my medication is next to the park. (Ilacimi aldigim eczane parkin yaninda.)

stem: The doctor _____ patients always recover quickly is Dr. Yilmaz.
explanation_tr: Aitlik/sahiplik bildirmek icin 'whose' kullanilir. Hastalari her zaman hizla iyilesen doktor Dr. Yilmaz.
tip_tr: Whose'dan sonra her zaman bir isim gelir (whose patients, whose car).
extra_example: The patient whose blood type is O-negative needs a transfusion. (Kan grubu O-negatif olan hastanin nakle ihtiyaci var.)

stem: The ambulance _____ arrived first took the patient to the nearest hospital.
explanation_tr: Ambulans bir nesne/aractir. 'That' veya 'which' kullanilabilir. Ilk gelen ambulans hastayi en yakin hastaneye gotururdu.
tip_tr: First, only, superlative gibi ifadelerden sonra that tercih edilir.
extra_example: The first treatment that worked was chemotherapy. (Ise yarayan ilk tedavi kemoterapiydi.)

stem: I remember the day _____ I was discharged from the hospital.
explanation_tr: Zaman bildiren isimlerden sonra 'when' kullanilir. Hastaneden taburcu oldugum gunu hatirliyorum.
rule_tr: Zaman ismi (day, year, time) + ilgi cumlesi = when
tip_tr: Day, moment, year, time gibi zaman ifadelerinden sonra when kullan.
extra_example: The moment when the doctor announced the good news was unforgettable. (Doktorun iyi haberi aciklama ani unutulmazdi.)

stem: The nurse _____ I spoke to said the visiting hours end at 8 p.m.
explanation_tr: Insan + nesne konumunda bile who kullanilabilir (whom daha resmi). Konustugum hemsire ziyaret saatlerinin 20:00'de bittigini soyledi.
tip_tr: Resmi dilde whom, gunluk dilde who veya that kullanilabilir.
extra_example: The surgeon who I consulted recommended the operation. (Danistigim cerrah ameliyati onerdi.)

stem: The blood test _____ I had last week showed normal results.
explanation_tr: Kan testi bir nesnedir. 'That' veya 'which' kullanilir. Gecen hafta yaptigim kan testi normal sonuclar gosterdi.
rule_tr: Nesne + tanimlayan ilgi cumlesi = that / which
tip_tr: That daha yaygin ve dogaldir, ozellikle konusma dilinde.
extra_example: The X-ray that the doctor ordered revealed no fractures. (Doktorun istedigi rontgen kirik gostermedi.)

stem: The clinic _____ I get my vaccinations is on Main Street.
explanation_tr: Klinik bir yerdir. Yer belirten isimlerden sonra 'where' kullanilir. Asilarimi oldugun klinik Ana Cadde'de.
tip_tr: Where = in which. Ikisi de dogrudur ama where daha dogal.
extra_example: The room where the patients rest is very quiet. (Hastalarin dinlendigi oda cok sessiz.)

stem: Patients _____ have diabetes need to monitor their blood sugar levels regularly.
explanation_tr: Insanlari tanimlamak icin 'who' kullanilir. Diyabet hastalari kan seker duzeylerini duzenli olarak izlemelidir.
tip_tr: Who'dan sonra fiil geliyorsa ozne zamiri, isim geliyorsa whose olabilir.
extra_example: Nurses who specialize in pediatrics work in the children's ward. (Pediatri alaninda uzmanlasan hemsireler cocuk servisinde calisir.)

stem: Dr. Ozkan, _____ is a renowned cardiologist, performed the heart surgery.
explanation_tr: Non-defining (virgullu) ilgi cumlesinde insan icin 'who' kullanilir. 'That' non-defining cumlede KULLANILMAZ.
tip_tr: Virgul varsa THAT kullanma! Bu en sik sorulan tuzaklardan biri.
extra_example: My mother, who is a retired nurse, still volunteers at the clinic. (Emekli hemsire olan annem hala klinikte gonullu calisir.)

stem: Aspirin, _____ is one of the most common medications, was first developed in 1897.
explanation_tr: Non-defining (virgullu) cumlede nesne icin 'which' kullanilir. That non-defining cumlede kullanilamaz.
tip_tr: Virgullu cumlede seceneklerde that varsa elimi, which veya who sec.
extra_example: Penicillin, which was discovered by Alexander Fleming, revolutionized medicine. (Alexander Fleming tarafindan kesfedilen penisilin, tipta devrim yapti.)

stem: The surgeon _____ team performed the transplant received an award.
explanation_tr: Sahiplik iliskisi bildirmek icin 'whose' kullanilir. Ekibi nakli gerceklestiren cerrah odul aldi.
rule_tr: Sahiplik + isim = whose + noun (whose team, whose car)
tip_tr: Whose + isim kalibini gor, sahiplik olup olmadigini kontrol et.
extra_example: The patient whose condition improved was sent home. (Durumu iyilesen hasta eve gonderildi.)

stem: The treatment _____ the doctor recommended was quite expensive.
explanation_tr: Tedavi bir nesnedir. Nesne icin 'which' veya 'that' kullanilir. Doktorun onerdigi tedavi oldukca pahaliydi.
tip_tr: Seceneklerde hem which hem that varsa ikisi de dogru olabilir ama cumleye en uygun olani sec.
extra_example: The diet which the nutritionist suggested helped me lose weight. (Diyetisyenin onerdigi diyet kilo vermeme yardimci oldu.)

stem: The emergency room, _____ was extremely crowded, had a four-hour waiting time.
explanation_tr: Virgullu (non-defining) cumlede nesne/yer icin 'which' kullanilir. That kullanilamaz.
tip_tr: Virgullu cumlede her zaman which (nesne) veya who (insan). ASLA that degil.
extra_example: The MRI machine, which costs over a million dollars, broke down yesterday. (Bir milyon dolardan fazla maliyeti olan MR cihazi dun bozuldu.)

stem: 2020 was the year _____ the COVID-19 pandemic changed healthcare systems worldwide.
explanation_tr: Zaman ifadelerinden (year, day, moment) sonra 'when' kullanilir. 2020, COVID-19 pandemisinin saglik sistemlerini degistirdigi yildi.
tip_tr: Year, day, time, moment = when. Place, city, hospital = where.
extra_example: I'll never forget the moment when I heard the diagnosis. (Teshisi duydugum ani asla unutmayacagim.)

stem: The specialist to _____ I was referred diagnosed my condition immediately.
explanation_tr: Preposition (to) + ilgi zamiri = whom (resmi). Sevk edildigi uzman durumumu hemen teshis etti.
tip_tr: To whom, with whom, for whom: edat + whom kalibini bil.
extra_example: The colleague with whom I work is a skilled anesthesiologist. (Birlikte calistigim meslektasim yetenekli bir anesteziyologdur.)

stem: My family doctor, _____ I have known for 20 years, is retiring next month.
explanation_tr: Non-defining cumlede insan nesne konumundaysa 'whom' veya 'who' kullanilir. That kullanilamaz.
tip_tr: Virgullu + insan + nesne konumu = whom (resmi) veya who (gunluk).
extra_example: The pharmacist, whom everyone in the neighborhood trusts, gave me good advice. (Mahalledeki herkesin guvendigi eczaci bana iyi tavsiye verdi.)

stem: The waiting room _____ we sat for three hours was very uncomfortable.
explanation_tr: Bekleme odasi bir yerdir. Yer bildiren isimlerden sonra 'where' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Yer + ilgi cumlesi = where (= in which)
tip_tr: Where yerine 'in which / at which' de kullanilabilir. Ikisi de dogru.
extra_example: The ward where my grandfather stayed was on the third floor. (Dedemin kaldigi servis ucuncu kattaydi.)

stem: The patients _____ in the ICU require 24-hour monitoring.
explanation_tr: Kisaltilmis ilgi cumlesi: 'who are treated' yerine 'treated' (past participle) kullanilir. Edilgen anlam var.
rule_tr: Kisaltilmis edilgen = V3 (who are treated → treated)
tip_tr: Edilgen anlam = V3 (treated, injured, admitted). Etken anlam = V-ing.
extra_example: The medicine prescribed by the doctor was very effective. (Doktor tarafindan yazilan ilac cok etkiliydi.)

stem: The nurse _____ after the patients in Ward 3 is very experienced.
explanation_tr: Kisaltilmis ilgi cumlesi: 'who is looking' yerine 'looking' (present participle) kullanilir. Etken ve devam eden anlam.
rule_tr: Kisaltilmis etken = V-ing (who is looking → looking)
tip_tr: Etken + simdiki zaman = V-ing. Kim ne yapiyor sorusuna cevap verir.
extra_example: The doctor examining the patient noticed something unusual. (Hastayi muayene eden doktor olagan disi bir sey fark etti.)

stem: The new hospital wing, _____ construction took three years, was finally opened last week.
explanation_tr: Sahiplik bildiren 'whose' non-defining cumlede de kullanilir. Insati uc yil suren yeni hastane kanadi gecen hafta acildi.
tip_tr: Whose sadece insanlar icin degil, nesneler icin de sahiplik bildirir.
extra_example: The clinic, whose reputation is excellent, attracts patients from all over the country. (Itibar bakimindan mukemmel olan klinik, ulkenin her yerinden hasta cekiyor.)

stem: Anyone _____ symptoms of the virus should isolate immediately.
explanation_tr: Kisaltilmis etken ilgi cumlesi: 'who is showing' yerine 'showing' kullanilir.
tip_tr: Anyone/those/people + V-ing = kisaltilmis ilgi cumlesi. Sinavda sik cikar.
extra_example: Students suffering from allergies should inform the school nurse. (Alerjiden muzdarip ogrenciler okul hemsiresini bilgilendirmelidir.)

stem: The operation was performed by Dr. Kaya, _____ specializes in neurosurgery.
explanation_tr: Non-defining cumlede insan ozne konumundaysa 'who' kullanilir. Dr. Kaya, norosirurji uzmani, ameliyati gerceklestirdi.
tip_tr: Ozel isimlerden sonra gelen ilgi cumlesi her zaman non-defining (virgullu) olur.
extra_example: Florence Nightingale, who is known as the founder of modern nursing, was born in 1820. (Modern hemsirelignin kurucusu olarak bilinen Florence Nightingale 1820'de dogdu.)

stem: The number of people _____ to the flu vaccine has increased this year.
explanation_tr: Kisaltilmis ilgi cumlesi: 'who are allergic' yerine sadece 'allergic' (sifat) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Kisaltilmis (be + sifat) = sifat (who are allergic → allergic)
tip_tr: Who are + sifat yapisi kisaltildiginda sadece sifat kalir.
extra_example: Patients eligible for the trial must sign a consent form. (Denemeye uygun hastalar onam formu imzalamalidir.)

stem: The only medication _____ effectively controlled her migraines was discontinued by the manufacturer.
explanation_tr: 'The only' ifadesinden sonra 'that' tercih edilir. Migrenlerini etkili bir sekilde kontrol eden tek ilac uretici tarafindan durduruldu.
rule_tr: The only / the first / superlative + that (tercih edilen)
tip_tr: Only, first, last, superlative gibi ifadelerden sonra which degil that tercih edilir.
extra_example: It was the worst diagnosis that the doctor had ever given. (Doktorun verdigi en kotu teshisti.)

stem: The patient refused chemotherapy, _____ surprised everyone in the medical team.
explanation_tr: Butun bir cumleye atifta bulunan non-defining cumlede 'which' kullanilir. Hastanin kemoterapiyi reddetmesi herkesi sasirtti.
tip_tr: Which butun bir cumleyi referans alabilir. Bu durumda 'bu durum/olay' anlamina gelir.
extra_example: He skipped his medication for a week, which caused his condition to worsen. (Bir hafta ilacini almadi, bu da durumunun kotulemesine neden oldu.)

stem: The medical equipment _____ in this lab was donated by a charity organization.
explanation_tr: Kisaltilmis edilgen: 'which is used' yerine 'used' (V3) kullanilir. Kullanilaln tibbi ekipman bagislandi.
rule_tr: Kisaltilmis edilgen = V3 (which is used → used)
tip_tr: Edilgen anlam (kullanilan, yapilan, uretilen) = V3 ile kisalt.
extra_example: The data collected from the study was published in a medical journal. (Calismadan toplanan veriler tibbi bir dergide yayinlandi.)

stem: The reason _____ the patient was transferred to another hospital was a lack of specialized equipment.
explanation_tr: 'The reason' ifadesinden sonra 'why' kullanilir. Hastanin baska bir hastaneye sevk edilme nedeni uzman ekipman eksikligiydi.
rule_tr: The reason + ilgi cumlesi = why (= for which)
tip_tr: The reason why = sebebi. Sinavda the reason which tuzagi olabilir, dikkat!
extra_example: The reason why the surgery was delayed was that the patient had an infection. (Ameliyatin ertelenmesinin nedeni hastanin enfeksiyon kapmasiydi.)
